text:
sam: deploy-bot paused the search-api canary citing a Chart.lock mismatch for search-indexer subchart. canary id=canary-search-2026-03. anyone free to triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: artifact digest mismatch. requested search-api v2.9.0 + search-indexer v1.7.0, deployed artifact references search-indexer v1.6.4. 6/50 pods failed readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. logs: /deploy/logs/1809007777

rita: quick look: PR bumped subchart to 1.7.0 but Chart.lock in artifacts still points to 1.6.4. chart-publisher likely skipped due to CI debounce.

sam: options: (1) manual pin to 1.6.4 to stop churn, (2) re-run chart-publish to push 1.7.0 and re-promote, (3) rollback. Ops preference?

ops-admin: prefer republish so artifacts reflect git. I'll approve publish. Meanwhile pin to reduce pod churn.

rita: applying pin now: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-search-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart=search-indexer-1.6.4 --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin annotation received. Canary will not replace pods for pinned subchart.

rita: running `make charts && chart-publisher --repo artifacts-internal --token $TOKEN`. Also running `helm diff` between 1.6.4 and 1.7.0 for default values.

oncall-sre: standby. recommend hold release window +30m after unpause for verification.

rita: diff: only default `indexer.threadCount` increased from 2 -> 3 and `timeout` bumped 200ms->250ms. no breaking config keys. publish ETA ~12m.

rita: publish completed. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/search-api/2.9.0+sub-search-indexer-1.7.0.tgz sha256: cafe1234 Promoted to artifacts repo.

sam: removing pin and unpausing: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-search-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart-; kubectl patch canary/canary-search-2026-03 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring 30m. Initial health checks passing.

rita: filing CI ticket to avoid skipped publishes on debounce (ticket #2468). adding release note: "search-indexer -> 1.7.0: default threadCount increased; timeout marginally increased. Artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/search-api/2.9.0+sub-search-indexer-1.7.0.tgz"

oncall-sre: monitoring metrics. will escalate if any regressions.

sam: closing thread for now unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
